howto: Press Play, then tap anywhere (or press Space) to throw a knife into the spinning log.
Never hit a knife that is already stuck in the log.
Stick every knife to split the log and reach the next stage; every fifth stage is a boss.
Slice apples for coins and spend them on new knives.
tips: Watch the bottom of the log: throw just after a stuck knife passes.
Stages 1 to 4 are a warm-up; from stage 2 some knives are already stuck in the log.
Beat the boss on stage 5, 10 and 15 for the Bark Splitter, Frost Fang and Ember Edge knives, and to save a checkpoint.
Throwing quickly in a row builds a Flow streak.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up arrow throws. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: An adaptive curve: stages 1 to 4 have a slow log and few stuck knives, then the log spins faster, may reverse or pulse, and more knives are stuck in it. Every fifth stage is a boss with its own spin pattern. Beaten bosses save a checkpoint you can start from.

cheats.effect: Slow log: every log spins at half speed
Ghost blade: knives slip past knives already in the log
Apple rain: a new apple keeps growing on the log

features.one-tap-start: Play, then the first tap throws and starts the run
features.instant-restart: Play Again on the Clash card starts a new run at once
features.best-score-badge: Best stage on the title and on the results card
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a tapping finger on the first run
features.results: Result card with stage reached, medal, best, top-5 runs, apples earned, today's goals and the next knife to unlock
features.progression: Nine knives (six bought with apples, three won from the bosses), boss checkpoints at stages 6, 11 and 16, three daily goals plus a star challenge, week stamps with a weekly gift
features.daily-goals: Three goals and one star challenge a day
